name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.38.0: a kiosk-language switch on each machine's Overview tab. Two buttons, Islenska and English, showing the machine's current default and setting it with one click; Polski appears when it is in that machine's available set. It writes defaultLanguageCode (is|en|pl), which is the field fridgeLanguageBlock actually builds the machine's config from. That matters, because the Kiosk-setup panel already had a default language select and it does nothing: it writes settings.defaultLanguage, the string 'Icelandic' or 'English', which reaches neither the machine nor, since saveDisplaySettings only touches localStorage, the backend. Setting it has never changed what a kiosk displays. The new control is per machine, where an operator is already standing when they notice the wrong language, and is open to any user with access to the machine rather than AG admin, since a language preference is not hardware wiring. Verified end to end in a browser: the buttons render with the live default selected, a click stores defaultLanguageCode = en, a fresh page load reads English back from the backend, and the config block the machine polls carries language default en with available [is, en]. Cumulative over v6.37.0.
